{"id":"P-COMPASS-330","uuid":"dfd0e730-e4d2-4847-87b2-44f664b5437f","icon":null,"color":"#4cb782","name":"SDK/API Customer Integration Path","summary":"Deliver a reusable, versioned SDK/API path that lets customers integrate Stellarus chat reliably for the September MVP using a custom UI and allows Stellarus to use different conversational AI tools other than Sierra.","description":"This project defines and delivers a Stellarus-owned, versioned SDK/API integration path that enables customer-controlled or Stellarus-hosted UI experiences to initiate chat sessions, stream broker responses, pass session metadata, handle standard errors, emit analytics hooks, and capture escalation events. The goal is to replace one-off, expensive solutions like Sierra or demo-only integration work with a repeatable customer integration model that can support the September MVP launch gate.\n\nThe work includes the SDK/API contract, configuration model, sample implementation, integration documentation, analytics hook points, and trace propagation requirements needed for external and internal implementers to integrate consistently across environments. Success depends on locking the v1 integration surface quickly, delivering escalation and analytics coverage in v2, and treating documentation and sample validation as exit criteria so the SDK/API path is launch-ready by mid-August.","url":"https://linear.app/stellarus/project/sdkapi-customer-integration-path-8652832f9ab6","resourceCount":2,"createdAt":"2026-06-24T15:38:21.865Z","updatedAt":"2026-10-12T19:26:26.577Z","startedAt":"2026-07-07T23:15:25.419Z","completedAt":null,"canceledAt":null,"startDate":"2026-06-24","startDateResolution":null,"targetDate":"2026-08-15","targetDateResolution":null,"priority":{"value":1,"name":"Urgent"},"labels":["Platform","Compass"],"initiatives":[{"id":"1859bffd-5b03-4170-9169-80773cb3946c","name":"Compass Platform"}],"lead":{"id":"ab5e858e-c973-4b8a-b8b4-1522ec7e80ff","name":"Jason Jackson"},"leadTeam":{"id":"23265ca4-2cf9-43e1-a28d-a54250d2aa60","name":"Compass","key":"COMPASS"},"status":{"id":"57df9e80-2ef4-4072-b0f6-f12ffc2aa073","name":"Build & Integrate","type":"started"},"teams":[{"id":"23265ca4-2cf9-43e1-a28d-a54250d2aa60","name":"Compass","key":"COMPASS"},{"id":"f34ae3ef-40ef-4813-b2a1-01791b15871c","name":"Product","key":"PRODUCT"},{"id":"16802391-2936-4847-afd3-fbf0f00ac0e9","name":"Engineering","key":"ENG"}],"resources":[{"type":"document","id":"5f610284-c831-49d3-a1ff-0dde10b1881f","title":"REQ-2026-SDK-A1 — SDK v1 Surface Lock Requirements","icon":null,"color":null,"url":"https://linear.app/stellarus/document/req-2026-sdk-a1-sdk-v1-surface-lock-requirements-43267e873ff1","createdAt":"2026-06-29T22:31:05.407Z","updatedAt":"2026-07-01T16:39:54.108Z"},{"type":"document","id":"72bf625c-3545-4dcd-ac8e-14a080e8b6ff","title":"SDK/API Customer Integration Path","icon":"Page","color":"#4cb782","url":"https://linear.app/stellarus/document/sdkapi-customer-integration-path-29a1080e5e71","createdAt":"2026-06-24T15:38:23.218Z","updatedAt":"2026-06-26T12:17:24.398Z"}]}

{"id":"P-COMPASS-331","uuid":"ba510a06-aa15-4ef7-a2eb-88ca05e607cb","icon":null,"color":"#4cb782","name":"Tenant Context and Auth Spine","summary":"Establish a fail-closed tenant context and authorization spine across the MVP stack so every request is validated, scoped, traceable, and isolated by customer.","description":"This project establishes the shared tenant context and authorization spine required for MVP readiness across the UI/BFF, broker, and Benefits Service. It standardizes how CCS-issued context tokens are validated and propagated so customer slug, persona, principal, scopes, and correlation IDs are enforced consistently at every service boundary, with fail-closed behavior for missing, malformed, expired, unauthorized, or tenant-mismatched context.\n\nThe work is aimed at reducing cross-tenant data risk, increasing support traceability, and giving security and privacy stakeholders clear verification evidence before launch. Success depends on one shared contract across services, reliable correlation ID propagation, sensitive-log redaction, and release-candidate validation that proves tenant isolation, scope enforcement, and observable error handling across the MVP On the legacy path the broker calls CSR Chat with one shared CCS key (`csr-chat-api-key`). * Support CSR, member, and provider personas initially.
* Keep the mechanism extensible for future personas without code-wide changes.

`user_id`, `user_name`, and `question_id` are now optional on the wire. When omitted, they derive from the CCS-verified context token: `user_id` = principal id, `user_name` defaults to the resolved `user_id`, `question_id` = server-minted UUID per request.

Derivation **requires** a verified context token. Without one (token auth disabled, e.g. prd today) the endpoint keeps its pre… (truncated, use `get_issue` for full description)","url":"https://linear.app/stellarus/issue/COMPASS-475/csr-chat-make-agentchat-broker-compatible","updatedAt":"2026-10-12T23:29:57.353Z"},{"id":"COMPASS-480","title":"Epic: Multi-Persona / Multi-Customer CSR Chat","status":"Done","description":"Parent epic for the Multi-Persona / Multi-Customer Chat workstream.

Purpose
Coordinate app, APIM/CCS, Benefit Service, tenant storage-boundary, persona routing, observability, and tech-spec work without overlapping ownership.

Launch framing

{"id":"P-APP-217","uuid":"703af5ef-d2d1-4980-b164-661b557287ce","icon":null,"color":"#bec2c8","name":"Benefits service","summary":"Micro service that exposes benefits data via API","description":"The benefits service is a micro service in the Stellarus eco-system that can provide consumers with a JSON structured version of the benefits from a customer.

**Data:** Data should be updated daily, and should be inserted as new rows with inserted timestamps, into the customer specific data store.

**Data and request tracking:** Each request should be logged in the database including which data id was returned, making it possible answer questions like: *"what does benefit data looks like for request id XYZ"* 

**Data sensitivity: No PHI** 
The dataset set is small and static (infrequently updated) and contains no PHI.

**Security and Access: Customer specific API Key**
The data should to be available from an API and use an API key as assigned to the customer.

**Logging**
All traffic and requests should be logged using standard logging and flow into the platform for general observability.

**Versioning**
Endpoints should be versioned in the endpoint path (ex. /v1/benefits...)

**API documentation**: OpenAPI/swagger

### Project dependency: 

BSC Inbound calls redirect to Sierra.ai to answer benefits questions. 

This is the fist step for the project to establish the initial connection/collaboration between BSC callcenter utilizing Stellarus services, long term plan is for Genesys to connect to Stellarus Agentic API (different project).

**Flow (simplified)**: Genesys -> [Sierra.ai](<http://Sierra.ai>) -> Benefits service API

### Nexus Data sync

The benefits data is currently in Nexus, we need a daily task that fetches the data and makes the data available under the customer datastore in the benefits service database. 

**Dependency**: Data team 

### 

**Open questions:** 

* Database: Cosmo or Postgres
* Data model: do we use the same model as Nexus provides or come up with a customer agnostic model? V1: use current. V2: revisit when adding new customer and release under new version
* Daily task: Post data to internal service endpoint?
* Alerts: Who/team should sync alerts be going to?
* Handling of API key management across the platform (Security / Platform)
* API gateway on top of our micro service we expose to the public? Pattern/DNS
* <linear-comment id="ddf2c058-529c-4085-9041-75fadaa146b1" resolved="false">How to fetch benefits data that is not stored in Nexus (Specialty plans and EOCs). There are hundreds of these plans across dental and medical for all BSC LOBs. </linear-comment>

**Related project code:** Minerva - benefits chat, pulls the data on a daily basis: [https://github.com/stellarus-dev/nexus-benefits-quote](<https://github.com/stellarus-dev/nexus-benefits-quote>)

**Resources required:** 

**Apps team**: 1 - development/deployment  

**Data team**: 1 - scheduling tasks

**Security** : 1 - consultant, establish an re-useable secure pattern for clients to access the data from API
